name: Oohara Kaede
source:
Former registered nurse and Asuka's nurse instructor.  Born in the "Oohara" family known for their exceptional influence in medicine.  Chose to go to the Imperial Capital Nursing Technical School to work as a teacher after serving as an RN.  She's the "White Robe Angel", according to Asuka.

[Translated from [url=http://hakuai.kogado.com/character/#kaede]Official Site[/url]]
